user.title: Connect to your iLedClock
user.description: Pick the iLedClock to add. If none are listed, make sure it is powered on and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This clock is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No iLedClocks were found. Make sure it is powered on and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

init.description: The password must match the {password_length}-character password stored on the clock itself (default 000000). The Divoom account is optional, for browsing the online gallery's Divoom source -- leave the password blank to keep the one already saved.

data.time_sync: Keep the clock's time synced automatically
data.divoom_password: Divoom account password (optional, leave blank to keep the current one)

error.invalid_password: The password must be exactly 6 hex characters (0-9, a-f).

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Show a text message on the clock right now. The message is drawn as pixels; one that is wider than the clock scrolls. With a duration, whatever was on screen A before is put back automatically afterwards -- a notify-style temporary message.

device_id.name: Clock
device_id.description: The clock to show the message on.

text.name: Text
text.description: The message to display, up to 120 characters.

color.name: Colour
color.description: The text colour as red, green and blue (0-255 each). White if left empty. The rainbow modes ignore it.

color_mode.name: Colour mode
color_mode.description: 1 = one colour, 2 = a rainbow along the text, 4 = every letter a different colour. The other numbers (3 and 5-28) also give one colour.

is_bold.name: Bold
is_bold.description: Make every letter one pixel wider. Off by default: bold text is wider, so fewer letters fit before it has to scroll.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast a scrolling message moves, from 0 (a still picture) to 100 (the fastest the clock can play). Leave empty for the normal reading pace.

smooth.name: Smooth motion
smooth.description: Add in-between frames so a slowed-down scroll moves in smaller steps. Leave empty for automatic (on).

duration_s.name: Duration
duration_s.description: Seconds to show this message before putting back what screen A showed before. Leave empty to keep the message until something else is shown. Only works on screen A.

slot.name: Screen
slot.description: Which of the clock's two screens to write to: a = the program list (the default), b = the clock-page screen. The clock's power button switches between them. Screen B only takes clock, date and temperature pages for now.

show_design.name: Show design
show_design.description: Show a saved pixel-art image or animation on the clock right now.

device_id.name: Clock
device_id.description: The clock to show the design on.

design_id.name: Design
design_id.description: The saved design's id, from the Pixel Studio panel or iledclock/designs/list.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast to play it, from 0 (a still picture) to 100 (the fastest the clock can play). Leave empty to use the design's saved speed, or the animation's own timing.

smooth.name: Smooth motion
smooth.description: Add in-between frames to sliding and fading steps when the animation is slowed down. Leave empty for the design's saved choice (on by default).

slot.name: Screen
slot.description: Which of the clock's two screens to write to: a = the program list (the default), b = the clock-page screen. The clock's power button switches between them. Screen B only takes clock, date and temperature pages for now.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Import a photo, GIF, or other image and show it on the clock right now.

device_id.name: Clock
device_id.description: The clock to show the image on.

url.name: URL
url.description: An image URL to fetch. Provide this or Image data, not both.

data_b64.name: Image data
data_b64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes. Provide this or URL, not both.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: How to fit the image onto the 32x16 panel: contain, cover, or stretch.

dither.name: Dither
dither.description: Dither the image when reducing it to the panel's colours.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast to play it, from 0 (a still picture) to 100 (the fastest the clock can play). Leave empty to use the design's saved speed, or the animation's own timing.

smooth.name: Smooth motion
smooth.description: Add in-between frames to sliding and fading steps when the animation is slowed down. Leave empty for the design's saved choice (on by default).

slot.name: Screen
slot.description: Which of the clock's two screens to write to: a = the program list (the default), b = the clock-page screen. The clock's power button switches between them. Screen B only takes clock, date and temperature pages for now.

show_generative.name: Show generative animation
show_generative.description: Show a procedurally generated animation (fire, plasma, starfield, ...) on the clock right now.

device_id.name: Clock
device_id.description: The clock to show the animation on.

seconds.name: Duration
seconds.description: How many seconds of animation to generate.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Optional random seed, for a reproducible result.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast to play it, from 0 (a still picture) to 100 (the fastest the clock can play). Leave empty to use the design's saved speed, or the animation's own timing.

smooth.name: Smooth motion
smooth.description: Add in-between frames to sliding and fading steps when the animation is slowed down. Leave empty for the design's saved choice (on by default).

slot.name: Screen
slot.description: Which of the clock's two screens to write to: a = the program list (the default), b = the clock-page screen. The clock's power button switches between them. Screen B only takes clock, date and temperature pages for now.

set_playlist.name: Set playlist
set_playlist.description: Replace the whole rotation of programs the clock cycles through.

playlist.name: Playlist
playlist.description: Up to 9 items, each an object with kind, params, and duration_s.

clock_face.name: Set clock face
clock_face.description: Show one of the 41 built-in clock styles right now, with full control over colour and 12/24-hour mode.

hours24.name: 24-hour
hours24.description: Use 24-hour time instead of 12-hour with AM/PM.

show_seconds.name: Show seconds
show_seconds.description: Include a seconds field, when there is room for one.

background.name: Face background
background.description: Show the style's own background art behind the digits, like the vendor app does. Turn off for a plain firmware clock on a blank panel.

slot.name: Screen
slot.description: Which of the clock's two screens to write to: a = the program list (the default), b = the clock-page screen. The clock's power button switches between them. Screen B takes clock faces.

countdown_reset.name: Reset countdown
countdown_reset.description: Set the clock's countdown timer to a new starting duration.

countdown_run.name: Start/stop countdown
countdown_run.description: Start or pause the countdown timer.

start.name: Start
start.description: True to start, false to stop/pause.

stopwatch_reset.name: Reset stopwatch
stopwatch_reset.description: Reset the clock's stopwatch to zero.

start.name: Start
start.description: True to start, false to stop/pause.

scoreboard_set_score.name: Set scoreboard score
scoreboard_set_score.description: Set the home and away scores.

scoreboard_set_time.name: Set scoreboard time
scoreboard_set_time.description: Set the scoreboard's clock, counting up or down.

count_down.name: Count down
count_down.description: Count down from this time instead of counting up.

scoreboard_run.name: Start/stop scoreboard clock
scoreboard_run.description: Start or pause the scoreboard's clock.

start.name: Start
start.description: True to start, false to stop/pause.

set_alarms.name: Set alarms
set_alarms.description: Replace the whole alarm list (up to 16 entries).

alarms.name: Alarms
alarms.description: Up to 16 objects, each with hour, minute, enabled, and repeat (a Mon-Sun bitmask: 0 = once, 127 = every day).

set_timer_switches.name: Set timer switches
set_timer_switches.description: Replace the whole timer-switch list (up to 4 entries) that turns the display on or off automatically.

timer_switches.name: Timer switches
timer_switches.description: Up to 4 objects, each with hour, minute, on, enabled, and repeat (a Mon-Sun bitmask: 0 = once, 127 = every day).

set_pomodoro.name: Set pomodoro durations
set_pomodoro.description: Replace the pomodoro/tomato timer's list of durations (1-6 entries, in minutes).

night_mode.name: Set night mode
night_mode.description: Configure night mode's schedule, dimming/off behaviour, and voice-wake settings, all at once.

device_off.name: Turn display off
device_off.description: Turn the display off during night mode, instead of just dimming it.

brightness.name: Night brightness
brightness.description: Brightness to use during night mode when the display isn't turned off (0-100).

wake_minutes.name: Wake duration
wake_minutes.description: How many minutes the display wakes for on motion/voice.

voice.name: Wake on voice
voice.description: Wake the display on voice during night mode.

reminder_set.name: Set alarm or reminder
reminder_set.description: Create an alarm or reminder, or change one. It is stored on the clock itself, so it still rings when Home Assistant is off. The clock has 16 reminder slots; repeating on several days can use more than one. Answers with the saved item, including its key.

device_id.name: Clock
device_id.description: The clock to put it on.

key.name: Key
key.description: Leave empty to make a new one. To change one, give the key this service returned when it was made.

name.name: Name
name.description: What the clock shows when it rings. Up to 20 characters.

time.name: Time
time.description: The time of day it rings.

kind.name: Type
kind.description: Alarm or reminder. Only changes how it is listed; the clock rings both the same way.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How often it rings. One time if left out.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day for a one-time alarm, the day of the month (1 to 28) for a monthly one, or the date for a yearly one.

days.name: Days
days.description: The weekdays for Custom (any number) or Weekly (exactly one).

duration_s.name: Ring length
duration_s.description: How long it rings, in seconds.

design_id.name: Picture
design_id.description: A Library design to show while it rings. Leave empty to show the name as scrolling text.

enabled.name: On
enabled.description: Whether it is switched on. A switched-off alarm is removed from the clock but kept here.

reminder_set_enabled.name: Switch alarm or reminder on or off
reminder_set_enabled.description: Turn an alarm or reminder on (it is written to the clock) or off (it is removed from the clock but kept here).

key.name: Key
key.description: The key of the alarm or reminder.

reminder_delete.name: Delete alarm or reminder
reminder_delete.description: Delete an alarm or reminder. Give the key of one made in Home Assistant, or the ID of one that exists only on the clock (made with the clock's own app).

key.name: Key
key.description: The key of an alarm or reminder made in Home Assistant. Use this or the ID, not both.

id.name: Reminder ID
id.description: The clock's own ID of a reminder made elsewhere, from the clock's reminder list. Use this or the key, not both.

sync_time.name: Sync time
sync_time.description: Send Home Assistant's current date and time to the clock right now.

release_link.name: Release Bluetooth link
release_link.description: Disconnect from the clock now, freeing the Bluetooth link for other uses (the vendor app, another proxy client).

send_raw.name: Send raw command
send_raw.description: Advanced: send a raw, unframed opcode and payload directly to the clock. For protocol features with no dedicated service (e.g. music-reactive mode), or troubleshooting.

payload_hex.name: Payload (hex)
payload_hex.description: The rest of the payload, as a hex string. Leave empty for an opcode with no payload.

timeout_s.name: Timeout
timeout_s.description: How long to wait for a reply, in seconds.

switch_screen.name: Switch screen
switch_screen.description: Presses the clock's power key once, which flips between screen A and screen B. It only toggles: the clock does not say which screen is showing, so run it again to go back.

unknown_device.message: {device_id} is not a loaded iLedClock device.
